rationale: C02 supplies a concrete drafting template for the child: an entity adopts an official emblem, an official recommends presidential approval, the accompanying design is incorporated into the order, the emblem is described in detail, and a final recital declares the design suitable and appropriate. C07 uses nearly the same machinery and language, but C02 more closely matches the child's separate adoption and recommendation clauses. C03 is relevant mainly for its incorporation and technical description of an official flag, with less correspondence in the surrounding approval formula.

shared_material.child_excerpt: has adopted, and has recommended that I approve, an official flag ... the design of which accompanies and is hereby made a part of this order
shared_material.parent_excerpt: has ... adopted a corporate seal; and ... has recommended that I approve such seal, the design of which accompanies and is hereby made a part of this order
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel language and the same sequence of adoption, recommendation, presidential approval, and incorporation of an accompanying design.

shared_material.child_excerpt: which is described as follows: United States Navy Flag. The flag ...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: which is described in heraldic terms as follows: On a sea green disk ...
shared_material.explanation: Both orders follow the approval recital with a detailed technical description of the emblem.

shared_material.child_excerpt: AND WHEREAS it appears that such flag is of suitable design and appropriate for adoption as the official flag
shared_material.parent_excerpt: AND WHEREAS it appears that such seal is of suitable design and appropriate for use as the corporate seal
shared_material.explanation: The concluding recital is an almost literal template adapted from a corporate seal to a Navy flag.
